case_classification.short_description: Algorithmic route planning for an Airline - different planning categories

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task requires solving a complex network routing/shortest path problem on a graph of 144 airports and over 300 bidirectional connections. To calculate the shortest paths by time, distance, cost, and stopovers while strictly adhering to the specified tie-breaking rule (based on the original row order in the Connections sheet), an expert modeler must implement a custom Dijkstra or BFS algorithm (most likely in VBA or Python). Setting up the Haversine distance formula, mapping out starting/landing fees, implementing the graph search with custom tie-breaking, post-processing the paths to concatenate unique countries/continents alphabetically, and mapping the results to the 80 specific questions will take a highly skilled modeler over two hours to build and verify.
